BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC has purchased 415,697 of its own ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities at a volume-weighted average price of 899.7400 pence per share, with the highest price paid being 906.8000 pence and the lowest at 892.6000 pence. These repurchased shares will be cancelled as part of the company's ongoing share buyback program, which is scheduled to conclude by June 5, 2026. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 28 April 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 ⁴/₇₇ pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from Morgan Stanley & Co. International plc ("Morgan Stanley"). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
